messages:
maria: FYI after the RBAC prune that went out ~03:00 UTC we started seeing cert fetch failures from keystore-service in eu-central and us-west. mTLS handshake fallback to TLS1.2 observed.
josh: ack. any immediate customer impact?
maria: a few internal downstream jobs retried and succeeded, but a handful of prod svc-to-svc calls logged transient 5xx from proxy. No P0s yet.
kevin: seeing KMS decrypt DENY entries in audit around the same time?
maria: yes — looks correlated. sample from proxy logs: ```
2026-02-11T03:04:12Z proxy[ingress] WARN handshake failed: tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-02-11T03:04:12Z keystore-client ERROR fetch cert: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc=KMS decrypt denied for key projects/redwood/keys/keystore-key
```
anika: the RBAC prune removed a broad binding for group:infra-keystore-readers last night. That group had a serviceAccount allowance used by the keystore proxy.
josh: can someone paste the exact IAM audit log entry?
maria: from CloudAudit: ```
protoPayload.methodName: "SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.request.policy.bindings: - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter - members: ["group:infra-keystore-readers@redwood.com"]
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "infra-admin@redwood.com"
```
kevin: so the policy was removed, and the keystore proxy's SA lost decrypt access. KMS returned PERMISSION_DENIED -> keystore returned 500 -> proxy aborted TLS handshake and fallback happened.
anika: timeline idea: RBAC prune -> binding removed -> keystore rotation attempted -> decrypt denied -> cert fetch fails -> mTLS handshake fails -> fallback to TLS -> some requests retried -> 5xx spike.
maria: mitigation options: 1) rollback the RBAC prune for infra-keystore-readers group (fast), 2) grant a scoped temporary binding to the specific serviceAccount(s), 3) hotpatch keystore to cache previous key material for 1h. Thoughts?
josh: 1) seems simplest. but we should avoid blanket re-add. prefer 2) scoped binding to svc accounts.
kevin: we should also add an audit alert for any KMS.Decrypt DENY spikes in next 24h. quick detection query: ```
resource.type="cloud_kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" AND protoPayload.status.code=7
```
maria: noted. I'll open a short-lived rollback PR and target infra-admin to approve.
anika: adding: check CT/OCSP impact — some downstream clients may drop connections if cert chain changed unexpectedly. Any CT errors in logs?
kevin: found one: ```
OCSP stapling: response missing for cert serial 0x4f2a
CT: SCT not present, but our proxies accept without CT for internal CA
```
maria: good call — internal CA policy allows no CT but we should monitor.
sre-oncall: is there an incident runbook trigger? Thresholds?
josh: if >1% of interregion svc calls fail for 10m escalate to incident. We're at 0.6% right now and trending down.
anika: post-mortem checklist: - record RBAC diff and PR id - map group membership that relied on binding - timeline with KMS audit entries - assess if keys were rotated during the window - decide if we need longer-lived allow for the keystore SA or a more granular role (custom role with decrypt on specific key-version).
kevin: long term: require a canary for RBAC prunes that cross-serviceAccount principals, running a dry-run that queries KMS policy simulation for affected SAs. Could be a ci-check: ```
for sa in affected_sas: gcloud iam policies-simulate --principal=sa --permission=cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt ...
```
maria: +1. Also add an audit-sleuth playbook snippet for future: how to pivot from KMS DENY -> service identity -> RBAC change -> mitigation. Keep it short.
josh: tl;dr: rollback temporary, add scoped binding, add alert and postmortem. I'll coordinate the rollback PR.
security-bot: [alert] KMS decrypt deny spike detected (see runbook link) :rotating_light:
maria: thanks — assigning postmortem to me and anika. Will update with PR link and audit log slices.
anika: I'll follow up with infra-admin to tighten the RBAC prune script so it doesn't remove groups used by keystore svc.
kevin: also let's add a telemetry dashboard panel: keystore KMS decrypt denies, proxy cert-fetch latency, mTLS handshake failures by region.
maria: cool. I'll post status updates in #incidents if anything changes. :thumbsup:
